title: EU AI Act transparency duties and GPAI enforcement powers apply
summary: Article 50 labeling and disclosure duties (chatbot disclosure, deepfake labels, machine-readable marking) took effect and the AI Office began enforcement on general-purpose models; high-risk rules were delayed to Dec 2027 by the Digital Omnibus.
reason: Binding EU obligations now enforceable, tempered by the high-risk delay.

title: California AI Transparency Act (SB 942) takes effect
summary: Large generative-AI providers in California must offer provenance marks and AI-detection tools.
